catalogue_status: Authored implementation brief; not built game assets

courses.name: Hinode Driving Grounds
courses.sectors: Wide apron into a gentle slalom; a banked demonstration bend; separate drift circle and recovery bay
courses.landmarks: Timing pavilion; striped braking lane; wind-sock gantry
courses.default_conditions: Dry daylight with a separately selected wet practice section
courses.design_note: The skid pad is not part of a paid race route; six independent training bays and a shared non-contact loop.

courses.name: Tea Lantern Road
courses.sectors: Broad opening left; two mild alternating bends through fields; one clearly sighted hairpin before a flat finish
courses.landmarks: Tea-drying shed; low stone bridge; hanging lantern row
courses.design_note: Teach braking and exit speed; broad safe shoulders, no blind punishment on the first race.

courses.name: Mizuhana Switchback
courses.sectors: Village-edge acceleration; five deliberately unequal hairpins; an opening-radius final S
courses.landmarks: Terraced tea rows; split retaining wall; hilltop water tank
courses.design_note: Different climbing ratios matter; never mirror the same hairpin five times.

courses.name: Canal Orchard Ring
courses.sectors: Canal-side sweep; tight orchard offset; raised bridge braking into long exit
courses.landmarks: Canal sluice; greenhouse frames; covered packing yard
courses.design_note: Provide a genuinely closed loop, clear lap gates and a distinct overpass silhouette.

courses.name: Bellmaker Descent
courses.sectors: Fast hill shoulder; compression into linked corners; late double-apex right by workshops
courses.landmarks: Bell workshop wheel; stone stair wall outside course; red covered footbridge
courses.design_note: Lieutenant rematch location; visually teach not every entrance should be attacked at full speed.

courses.name: Cedar Ribbon
courses.sectors: Dark cedar corridor; three rhythm esses; an open overlook followed by an off-camber turn
courses.landmarks: Forest rail trestle; timber shelter; illuminated reservoir glimpse
courses.design_note: Foliage density varies by sector; readable edge reflectors and uncluttered apexes.

courses.name: Shrine Approach
courses.sectors: Long braking approach; steep zigzag below a wooded ridge; final paired bends onto a plateau
courses.landmarks: Distant shrine roof; cedar gate well outside road; old tram station
courses.design_note: The event uses the access road, not a sacred courtyard; retain cultural specificity without decorative nonsense.

courses.name: Mistglass Hollow
courses.sectors: Long visible entry sweeps; low valley mist over straight sections; tightening woodland sequence
courses.landmarks: Mossed aqueduct; fog-measuring mast; abandoned viewing platform
courses.default_conditions: Cool mist with maintained apex visibility
courses.design_note: Fog is atmospheric and telegraphed; never conceal road geometry beyond the safe stopping sight line.

courses.name: Rain Thread Pass
courses.sectors: Sheltered launch; wet cambered arcs; short tunnel into a long drainage-side descent
courses.landmarks: Rain chains at a shelter; yellow maintenance bridge; waterfall beside a tunnel exit
courses.design_note: Wet sheen, grip and AI line agree; no randomly placed invisible ice.

courses.name: Spillway Run
courses.sectors: Dam-crest crosswind section; braking past spillway gates; sheltered rising exit bends
courses.landmarks: Spillway towers; concrete fishway; flood-level markings
courses.design_note: Crosswind is primarily audiovisual in the baseline; do not add untested random steering forces.

courses.name: Hydroline Climb
courses.sectors: Powerhouse launch; multi-radius climbing turns; fast final shelf road
courses.landmarks: Switchyard silhouettes; pipeline arch; cable-service station
courses.design_note: Sustained ascent differentiates torque/gearing; road markings and power assets are original.

courses.name: Floodmark Circuit
courses.sectors: Lakeside kink; stepped retaining-wall sector; wide pump-yard exit
courses.landmarks: Water-level stair; twin pump houses; circular service tank
courses.design_note: No impossible loop connection: use a separate service viaduct to return to the starting basin.

courses.name: Blackwater Hairpins
courses.sectors: Quiet launch shelf; asymmetrical hairpin ladder; long braking turn after a tunnel
courses.landmarks: Flood memorial sign outside course; blue tunnel marker; spillway overlook
courses.design_note: A late-boss course: descent rhythm and brake release matter more than maximum power.

courses.name: Saltwind Viaduct
courses.sectors: Rising sea viaduct; linked cliff arcs; slow port-side finishing chicane
courses.landmarks: Lighthouse beam; rust-red bridge truss; coast railway below
courses.design_note: Fast sectors have safe barrier continuity and visibly different sea/land edges.

courses.name: Fishmarket Midnight
courses.sectors: Closed warehouse lane; market-roof S bends; quay-side braking into a square turn
courses.landmarks: Shuttered market signs; crane silhouettes; tiled freight office
courses.design_note: No active pedestrians or public traffic on the closed course; scenery extends beyond fence lines.

courses.name: Tide Lantern Coast
courses.sectors: Upland sweep; sea-wall undulations; three late-apex corners by the inlet
courses.landmarks: Storm gate; lit ferry terminal; stacked fishing floats behind fencing
courses.design_note: Road crowns and wet patches are authored/consistent for every entrant.

courses.name: Breakwater Ascent
courses.sectors: Harbour launch; steep cliff zigzag; broad high-road acceleration to finish
courses.landmarks: Breakwater lamps; hillside funicular; ridge radio dish
courses.design_note: Course rises out of the port instead of copying a forest track with a sea skybox.

courses.name: Slatecut Service Road
courses.sectors: Concrete loading apron; rock-cut alternating bends; a bridge over an inactive quarry
courses.landmarks: Stepped quarry walls; conveyor frame; surveyor hut
courses.design_note: Road is paved and closed; gravel shoulder has a clear physical boundary.

courses.name: Kilnlight Ring
courses.sectors: Broad kiln approach; tight cooling-yard loop; under-bridge compression with safe sight line
courses.landmarks: Brick kiln chimneys; cooling-tower ribs; enamel workshop mural
courses.design_note: Warm industrial windows and cooler exterior lighting create material contrast without neon overload.

courses.name: Switchyard Skyline
courses.sectors: Reservoir-link approach; descending-radius arcs beside pylons; climbing final hairpin group
courses.landmarks: Powerline crown; cantilever overlook; illuminated service lift
courses.design_note: Rhythm changes deliberately; no endless straight that decides the event solely by top speed.

courses.name: Ember Quarry Drop
courses.sectors: High quarry shelf; alternating braking/compression; long final descent into workshop valley
courses.landmarks: Red stone cutting face; steel lattice bridge; restored machine hall
courses.design_note: Final lieutenant location; fast road has broad recovery zones before the most severe bends.

courses.name: Moonridge Contour
courses.sectors: Open ridge arcs; old snow-shed transition; fast plateau S section
courses.landmarks: Moon-view pavilion; disused snow fence; distant observatory
courses.design_note: Cold visual palette without automatically adding ice; headlight falloff remains readable.

courses.name: White Pine Descent
courses.sectors: Pine-lined openers; long cambered descent; final triple bend around a frozen-looking rock face
courses.landmarks: White-bark pine grove; stone avalanche gallery; weather station
courses.design_note: Frost on scenery is not road ice; road-grip state is explicit and consistent.

courses.name: Signal Tower Climb
courses.sectors: Low antenna valley; steep and slow middle; high-flow ridge approach
courses.landmarks: Cable anchorage; transmitter service building; beacon mast
courses.design_note: Acceleration cannot replace a good exit; apex lighting makes the final climb learnable.

courses.name: Four Signals Traverse
courses.sectors: Four different sectors: technical entry; sustained drift arcs; braking descent; smooth high-road finish
courses.landmarks: Four coloured marshal beacons; stone gallery; old timing cabin
courses.design_note: Normal regular race first; S29 reuses the course with explicit four-contract mastery judging, not a new course ID.

courses.name: Amanagi Dawnline
courses.sectors: Ridge launch and linked switchbacks; long horizon sweep into tunnels; changing-radius descent into sunrise
courses.landmarks: Old radio relay arch; two-level valley bridge; sunrise finish above the sea
courses.default_conditions: Normal: night to dawn lighting; Hard: authored mist clearing into dawn
courses.design_note: At least five sectors and a unique route; lighting progression is deterministic, never changed grip or hidden hazards during the race.

cars.name: Kogane Hachi RS
cars.visual_identity: short wheelbase, narrow angular glasshouse, rectangular sealed lamps
cars.handling_identity: Responsive rotation and gentle power; lower straight-line speed; free starter choice.

cars.name: Mizuno Kite GT
cars.visual_identity: tall rear hatch, offset grille, wedge side windows
cars.handling_identity: Predictable entry and wet confidence; throttle understeer; free starter choice.

cars.name: Arata Rainfox 4
cars.visual_identity: squared arches, slim boot, divided rear lamps
cars.handling_identity: Stable traction and forgiving exits; more weight and less free rotation; free starter choice.

cars.name: Kogane Kestrel S
cars.visual_identity: low oval nose, small cabin, long open rear deck
cars.handling_identity: Momentum-focused; needs clean exits; removable roof is cosmetic.

cars.name: Shinmei Linea 20
cars.visual_identity: notched rear quarter, long bonnet, stacked corner lamps
cars.handling_identity: Flexible tuning; moderate chassis mass; lieutenant-friendly early build.

cars.name: Mizuno Sparrow Type-S
cars.visual_identity: short overhangs, arched roof, horizontal split grille
cars.handling_identity: Quick front-end response; must manage front grip when powering out.

cars.name: Arata Shigure GT
cars.visual_identity: long cargo roof, roof rails, six-window side profile
cars.handling_identity: Composed rough-road exits; slow rotation and higher braking demand.

cars.name: Hokusei Lanceray R
cars.visual_identity: compact trunk, raised hood intake, triangular lamp internals
cars.handling_identity: Strong exits and wet lines; can understeer with an aggressive diff.

cars.name: Shinmei Crestline 26
cars.visual_identity: broad shoulder, very long hood, recessed oval tail lamps
cars.handling_identity: Stable fast arcs; less agile in hairpins; strong linear pull.

cars.name: Kogane Spiral RX
cars.visual_identity: smooth teardrop cabin, rounded rear quarters, twin-slot lights
cars.handling_identity: Fast response/high revs; careful ratio choice matters on steep climbs.

cars.name: Mizuno Vector MR
cars.visual_identity: short nose, side cooling channels, angular buttresses
cars.handling_identity: Precise rotation and balance; needs smooth braking release.

cars.name: Shinmei Stormline 32
cars.visual_identity: broad rectangular silhouette, twin-intake nose, squared wing mounts
cars.handling_identity: Powerful traction but expensive momentum mistakes; not best on every course.

cars.name: Arata Comet S6
cars.visual_identity: low shark nose, tapered trunk, separate slim running lamps
cars.handling_identity: Good high-speed balance; steeper costs and grip-sensitive peak tune.

cars.name: Hokusei Vale R
cars.visual_identity: large fastback hatch, blade spoiler, tall front shoulders
cars.handling_identity: Unusual high-power FWD challenge; braking/exit planning beats brute force.

cars.name: Kogane Halo T
cars.visual_identity: short sculpted body, boxed rear haunches, low wraparound glass
cars.handling_identity: Big midrange torque; boost delivery can unbalance poor throttle control.

cars.name: Mizuno Meridian X
cars.visual_identity: low cabin-forward wedge, wide side intakes, deep rear diffuser
cars.handling_identity: Quick and exacting; never a mandatory purchase or universal best car.

cars.name: Shinmei Aurora 4S
cars.visual_identity: long roofline, muscular four-seat coupe stance, split rear bar
cars.handling_identity: Strong acceleration/stability; heavier braking and tyre loading.

cars.name: Hokusei Solstice Z
cars.visual_identity: compact cabin, deep sculpted doors, round-over rear deck
cars.handling_identity: High performance with controllable rotation; an alternative, not a required finale key.

crews.name: Tea Hour Motor Club
crews.identity: People who keep the morning tea deliveries and workshops moving; warm rivalries and small practical jokes.

crews.name: Rainline Atelier
crews.identity: A weather-conscious workshop collective; thoughtful preparation, different attitudes toward risk.

crews.name: Reservoir Section
crews.identity: Infrastructure workers, researchers and local competitors; precision without a single shared personality.

crews.name: Breakwater Union
crews.identity: Coastal craftspeople, night workers and performers; bold silhouettes, varied relationships to the port.

crews.name: Datum Works
crews.identity: A technically rigorous racing shop with internal disagreements about what a perfect result means.

crews.name: Zero Frequency
crews.identity: Independent highland veterans and newer observers linked by the old dawn-run legend, not a uniform team.

rivals.name: Sora Matsuda
rivals.appearance: slim; cropped hair; oversized delivery vest over striped sleeves; round key reel
rivals.personality: friendly fast talker who remembers everybody's order but forgets his own gloves
rivals.strength: preserves speed in open third-gear bends
rivals.weakness: overprotects momentum in very slow hairpins
rivals.intro_sample: A clean exit buys more than a brave entrance.

rivals.name: Hanae Okuno
rivals.appearance: broad shoulders; tied locs; canvas apron folded over dark overalls; ceramic pin
rivals.personality: a potter who treats practice as craft and finds boasting mildly funny
rivals.strength: stable brake release and repeatable entries
rivals.weakness: gives away space to committed late overtakes
rivals.intro_sample: I can do that corner again. Can you?

rivals.name: Kei Naruse
rivals.appearance: tall; asymmetric bob; cropped rain cape; checker cuff and ankle boots
rivals.personality: patient map collector who gets unexpectedly competitive about sector traces
rivals.strength: strong uphill exits and wet stability
rivals.weakness: carries too little speed into long sweepers
rivals.intro_sample: The map ends. The next bend does not.

rivals.name: Toma Fujii
rivals.appearance: stocky; curly high top; patched racing cardigan; bright laces
rivals.personality: a bicycle mechanic learning to trust four wheels without hiding his nerves
rivals.weakness: brakes too early under pressure
rivals.intro_sample: I fixed the brakes. Now I have to stop apologizing to them.

rivals.name: Yui Morisaki
rivals.appearance: petite; short side-swept hair; fitted bomber with tool-loop belt; enamel moth badge
rivals.personality: a night-shift technician with dry humour and meticulous notebooks
rivals.strength: protects legal inner lines without swerving
rivals.weakness: sacrifices exit when defending too long
rivals.intro_sample: There is room. It just is not where you hoped.

rivals.name: Akio Endo
rivals.appearance: heavyset; shaved head; long work coat over knitwear; flour-dusted shoes
rivals.personality: an easygoing baker who dislikes being mistaken for an easy opponent
rivals.strength: finds composed lines across rough transitions
rivals.weakness: slow to commit to a narrow passing opening
rivals.intro_sample: The road has a crust too.

rivals.name: Noa Ishida
rivals.appearance: athletic; braided undercut; sleeveless utility layer; large translucent watch
rivals.personality: a candid volunteer timekeeper who loves tidy data and untidy jokes
rivals.strength: links alternating corners with little steering correction
rivals.weakness: loses rhythm after an unexpected slow sector
rivals.intro_sample: That was almost a sentence. Try the next corner.

rivals.name: Daigo Ibuki
rivals.appearance: very tall; salt-and-pepper crop; rolled-sleeve shop jacket; heavy brass stopwatch
rivals.personality: first lieutenant; generous teacher who will not congratulate careless speed
rivals.strength: deep but controlled braking into tight turns
rivals.weakness: long gears leave a weak exit when baited into overbraking
rivals.intro_sample: Do not follow my brake lights. Find your own marker.

rivals.name: Rika Aonuma
rivals.appearance: long limbs; high ponytail; fitted waterproof smock; asymmetric reflective piping
rivals.personality: a botanist who notices changing grip before anyone notices rain
rivals.weakness: less decisive on a rapidly drying ideal line
rivals.intro_sample: Listen to the tyres, not the weather report.

rivals.name: Masato Kido
rivals.appearance: compact muscular build; swept-back hair; padded vest with narrow trousers; thumb ring
rivals.personality: a former courier who turns every trip into a carefully timed promise
rivals.strength: sets up two corners in advance for acceleration
rivals.weakness: can be surprised by a slower tightening apex
rivals.intro_sample: I promised I would arrive. I did not promise quietly.

rivals.name: Airi Shiba
rivals.appearance: short; twin braids; long knit scarf tucked safely into a short jacket; star barrette
rivals.personality: a music student who counts corners like phrases and hides frustration poorly
rivals.weakness: rushes the first turn after a mistake
rivals.intro_sample: You changed the beat. Good.

rivals.name: Rui Takeda
rivals.appearance: lean; shaved sides; quilted poncho shape; broad goggles at collar
rivals.personality: a reserved trail photographer with surprising appetite for a clean overtake
rivals.strength: turns wide setup into strong exits
rivals.weakness: gives away an inside opportunity on narrow roads
rivals.intro_sample: There is a better angle from out here.

rivals.name: Fumio Senda
rivals.appearance: round silhouette; moustache; short waxed coat; repair patches and knitted cap
rivals.personality: a forest-road maintainer protective of newcomers, impatient with excuses
rivals.weakness: conservative high-speed commitments
rivals.intro_sample: That patch was not there yesterday. It is there now.

rivals.name: Ena Kisaragi
rivals.appearance: tall angular build; close-cropped silver-dyed hair; long split-hem jacket; geometric earrings
rivals.personality: a sound engineer who hears a bad shift and cannot resist mentioning it
rivals.strength: keeps the engine in the useful band uphill
rivals.weakness: rarely risks a sudden alternate line
rivals.intro_sample: Your engine asked a question. You changed the subject.

rivals.name: Itsuki Hase
rivals.appearance: broad chest; wavy shoulder-length hair; sleeveless padded coat; stitched wristwrap
rivals.personality: a relaxed climber whose driving becomes exceptionally precise near exposure
rivals.strength: repeatable safe arcs on narrow elevated roads
rivals.weakness: lets an aggressive but clean rival dictate entry pace
rivals.intro_sample: Close to the edge is not the same as in control.

rivals.name: Emi Takanashi
rivals.appearance: medium height; coiled bun; long storm-grey coat with a distinctive asymmetric collar; cedar clasp
rivals.personality: second lieutenant; courteous meteorologist with a fierce dislike of lazy assumptions
rivals.strength: anticipates traction changes from surface and camber
rivals.weakness: dry-road maximum pace is less intimidating
rivals.intro_sample: The rain is not against you. It is information.

rivals.name: Shun Minato
rivals.appearance: slim; short curls; utility jumpsuit tied at waist; orange tape on one glove
rivals.personality: dam electrician, cheerfully impatient until precision is required
rivals.weakness: slow direction changes in the heavy chassis
rivals.intro_sample: Make the current work for you.

rivals.name: Kaede Ueno
rivals.appearance: tall strong build; long braid; cropped technical coat; silver mechanical pencil
rivals.personality: civil drafter, observant and gently sarcastic about extravagant racing lines
rivals.weakness: rigid commitment makes variable-radius bends awkward
rivals.intro_sample: You drew that line with your elbow.

rivals.name: Michi Kagawa
rivals.appearance: short rounded silhouette; fluffy hair; wide sleeves on a fitted waistcoat; water-level tag
rivals.personality: archivist who loves old mistakes because they make good warnings
rivals.strength: restores pace quickly after a slide
rivals.weakness: occasionally accepts a risk that was not necessary
rivals.intro_sample: I know this mistake. It has a good ending.

rivals.name: Ryo Senba
rivals.appearance: athletic; topknot; open-collar workshop tunic; narrow rectangular spectacles
rivals.personality: quiet machinist who explains little and demonstrates a great deal
rivals.weakness: needs clean braking on downhill entries
rivals.intro_sample: Watch the release, not the turn.

rivals.name: Natsumi Hori
rivals.appearance: compact; jagged bob; thick short jacket over tapered trousers; oversized headphones at neck
rivals.personality: radio editor who speaks in concise observations rather than slogans
rivals.strength: stays close without contact and waits for an error
rivals.weakness: can overinvest in following instead of passing
rivals.intro_sample: You looked in the mirror twice there.

rivals.name: Kenta Omi
rivals.appearance: large build; receding hair and beard; high-collar vest; fabric lunch bag
rivals.personality: maintenance supervisor with a long memory and infectious laugh
rivals.weakness: braking distance can be exploited
rivals.intro_sample: Good. Now do it when your hands are tired.

rivals.name: Sae Tsukada
rivals.appearance: long silhouette; straight waist-length hair in a low tie; tailored coveralls; thin red belt
rivals.personality: hydrologist, laconic until someone mistakes caution for fear
rivals.weakness: loses time when the radius unexpectedly tightens
rivals.intro_sample: The wide line only works when it comes back.

rivals.name: Jun Saegusa
rivals.appearance: slender; close shave; long white mechanic's coat with dark inner panels; small steel caliper
rivals.personality: third lieutenant; exacting builder who gradually admits that numbers need interpretation
rivals.weakness: predictable committed line gives a patient rival an opening
rivals.intro_sample: Measure twice. Brake once.

rivals.name: Hiroto Namioka
rivals.appearance: tall; loose swept hair; deck jacket with broad shoulder stripes; rope bracelet
rivals.personality: ferry mechanic, restless on land, hospitable in the garage
rivals.weakness: impatient through slow compound corners
rivals.intro_sample: The long way can still be the quick way.

rivals.name: Maya Kuroda
rivals.appearance: strong compact build; sharp bob; short leatherless racing jacket; triangular earrings
rivals.personality: poster artist who enjoys making an overtake look inevitable
rivals.weakness: stubborn defence can consume front grip
rivals.intro_sample: I left you a space. Not the one you chose.

rivals.name: Renji Sudo
rivals.appearance: broad; greying braided hair; long fisherman-style work coat; knitted wrist cuffs
rivals.personality: a patient boat repairer with an unexpectedly explosive sense of humour
rivals.weakness: boost can punish a rushed exit
rivals.intro_sample: That gear was a choice. Make it a good one.

rivals.name: Koharu Akiyama
rivals.appearance: very short; cropped curls; oversized varsity-style windbreaker; shell-shaped clip
rivals.personality: a dancer who treats the road as rhythm but hates being called naturally gifted
rivals.weakness: hesitates on isolated late-braking hairpins
rivals.intro_sample: It took practice to make that look easy.

rivals.name: Seiji Tanabe
rivals.appearance: thin and stooped; long untidy hair; layered rain jacket; folded harbour timetable
rivals.personality: night dispatcher, soft-spoken and impossible to hurry in conversation
rivals.weakness: gives away top-end aggression
rivals.intro_sample: There is still time to do the corner properly.

rivals.name: Akane Furuya
rivals.appearance: tall athletic; side braid; sleeveless quilted coat over bright undershirt; square medallion
rivals.personality: fitness instructor who is direct, supportive and intensely competitive
rivals.weakness: can be baited into a poor exit gear
rivals.intro_sample: You can be brave after you are accurate.

rivals.name: Yori Kamei
rivals.appearance: medium broad build; shaved head; long open utility shirt; woven pouch
rivals.personality: ceramic sign painter who prefers clever positioning to showing force
rivals.weakness: rarely capitalizes on a short straight alone
rivals.intro_sample: I am not rushing you. The finish is.

rivals.name: Mako Hoshino
rivals.appearance: tall; windswept short hair; dramatic cropped cape-like race jacket; copper ear cuff
rivals.personality: fourth lieutenant; charismatic former champion whose bravado protects a careful strategist
rivals.weakness: can sacrifice a straight by overrotating for style
rivals.intro_sample: Show me the line you would choose without an audience.

rivals.name: Tetsu Arimura
rivals.appearance: square build; close buzz cut; split-tone workshop suit; magnetic parts band
rivals.personality: test engineer who believes a repeated result is more interesting than a lucky one
rivals.weakness: predictable decisions under pressure
rivals.intro_sample: One good lap is a story. Three are evidence.

rivals.name: Chika Sakurai
rivals.appearance: slim; long asymmetric ponytail; high-waisted overalls; bright measuring-tape sash
rivals.personality: upholsterer with a sharp eye for a car's balance and a sharper wit
rivals.weakness: gives away early entry speed
rivals.intro_sample: The seat is comfortable. Do not get comfortable.

rivals.name: Naozumi Fuda
rivals.appearance: long-limbed; full beard; old racing waistcoat; repaired driving gloves
rivals.personality: engine builder, proud of naturally aspirated response and grudgingly fair about turbo cars
rivals.weakness: less aggressive in crowded opening sectors
rivals.intro_sample: Power is useful. Wasting it is expensive.

rivals.name: Lina Hayase
rivals.appearance: short athletic; tight curls; sculpted padded jacket; transparent tool pouch
rivals.personality: a bilingual workshop coordinator who translates everyone's excuses into useful tasks
rivals.strength: quick correction without a second overcorrection
rivals.weakness: sometimes relies on recovery instead of avoiding the first mistake
rivals.intro_sample: That is recoverable. Your pride may take longer.

rivals.name: Osamu Kitani
rivals.appearance: large relaxed build; side-parted grey hair; long shop apron over a knit vest; magnifier
rivals.personality: veteran tuner with elaborate tea preferences and very simple racing advice
rivals.weakness: less flexible when forced off his planned rhythm
rivals.intro_sample: The engine is not tired. You chose the wrong ratio.

rivals.name: Tsubasa Muraoka
rivals.appearance: tall narrow silhouette; spiked fringe; cropped reflective jacket; fingerless cuff on one arm
rivals.personality: industrial designer who loves experiments and keeps their failed prototypes
rivals.weakness: overexperiments on a closing-radius corner
rivals.intro_sample: The usual line was getting lonely.

rivals.name: Ayame Sugiura
rivals.appearance: medium build; short blunt fringe; tailored long vest; dark oval glasses
rivals.personality: quality inspector who notices an inconsistency before she notices a compliment
rivals.weakness: can be outpaced by someone who ignores the pressure
rivals.intro_sample: You were quicker before you started watching me.

rivals.name: Reina Kurogane
rivals.appearance: tall poised silhouette; sleek chin-length black hair; sharply tailored white-and-graphite race coat; single red seam
rivals.personality: Normal final boss, The Surveyor; believes solitary precision is the only reliable form of trust
rivals.strength: near-perfect linked braking and repeatable legal pace
rivals.weakness: commits too strongly to an ideal line when a different rhythm is needed
rivals.intro_sample: A convoy still reaches the corner one driver at a time.

rivals.name: Fuyu Tachibana
rivals.appearance: small; thick bob under a fleece cap; long insulated vest; mountain-flower patch
rivals.personality: observatory assistant whose nervous chatter disappears when driving
rivals.strength: clear judgement on narrow highland roads
rivals.weakness: overcautious through broad lowland corners
rivals.intro_sample: I can see the exit. That is enough.

rivals.name: Kazuma Yorita
rivals.appearance: broad stooped build; tousled grey curls; cable-knit jacket; old radio receiver
rivals.personality: radio repairer who heard the legendary run and refuses to embellish it
rivals.strength: sensitive to camber and cold-road transition
rivals.weakness: does not enjoy aggressive defending
rivals.intro_sample: The quiet part is where you hear the car.

rivals.name: Neri Takase
rivals.appearance: long angular silhouette; braided crown; asymmetrical long windbreaker; constellation brooch
rivals.personality: hiking guide who laughs at heroic stories but quietly makes sure everyone returns
rivals.weakness: needs discipline at blind-seeming but marked braking zones
rivals.intro_sample: Leave yourself a road home.

rivals.name: Satoshi Mibe
rivals.appearance: compact; shaved scalp and short beard; quilted jumpsuit; cloth-wrapped thermos
rivals.personality: snow-shed technician with blunt manners and an excellent memory for apprentices
rivals.weakness: loses flow across a long gentle sector
rivals.intro_sample: The marker is there for a reason. Then there is your reason.

rivals.name: Minae Otsuka
rivals.appearance: broad athletic; high knot; short heavy coat over narrow trousers; mountain rescue whistle
rivals.personality: former endurance mechanic who values consistency and checks other cars before her own
rivals.strength: low-waste lines over a long event
rivals.weakness: rarely uses a surprising short-term attack
rivals.intro_sample: Keep some of the car for the last hill.

rivals.name: Gaku Nishio
rivals.appearance: very tall thin; shoulder-length silver hair; old flight-style coat; round spectacles on cord
rivals.personality: retired train driver whose jokes arrive late and whose braking never does
rivals.weakness: modest power requires perfect exits
rivals.intro_sample: On time is a kind of fast.

rivals.name: Yuna Senzaki
rivals.appearance: short muscular; blunt cropped hair; loose mechanic's shirt; two embroidered glove cuffs
rivals.personality: a restoration specialist rebuilding the old dawn car with respect rather than nostalgia
rivals.weakness: tries too hard when the legend is watching
rivals.intro_sample: Old does not mean finished.

rivals.name: Shiori Kuze
rivals.appearance: compact upright silhouette; silver braid; worn indigo driving coat; repaired cream scarf tucked safely away
rivals.personality: Hard final boss, Zero Signal; the legendary dawn racer, patient and unshowy, testing observation rather than bravado
rivals.strength: extraordinary legal speed preservation, minimal steering and measured late release
rivals.weakness: lower power makes any actual loss of flow costly; no magical recovery
rivals.intro_sample: You do not have to hurry every part of the road.

campaign_stages.normal_story_beat: An invitation arrives with a timing slip, not a dare. Learn why the tea-road people race.
campaign_stages.hard_variation: dawn, damp; greater emphasis on smooth exits

campaign_stages.normal_story_beat: Kei says a convoy is a promise to wait at the next turnout; Toma calls that slow. Test the difference.
campaign_stages.hard_variation: blue hour, dry; tighter uphill benchmark

campaign_stages.normal_story_beat: The orchard loop exposes a disagreement between a good single sector and a repeatable lap.
campaign_stages.hard_variation: night, dry; two-lap consistency emphasis

campaign_stages.normal_story_beat: Hanae repairs a cracked cup while everyone argues about the fastest line. The return matters.
campaign_stages.hard_variation: pre-dawn, damp; late brake-release emphasis

campaign_stages.normal_story_beat: Rainline arrives prepared for weather nobody else noticed. Preparation becomes a personality.
campaign_stages.hard_variation: night, damp; alternate legal exit lines

campaign_stages.normal_story_beat: The roadside radio mentions an unrecorded dawn run, then changes the subject.
campaign_stages.hard_variation: clear dawn, dry; reduced margin for early braking

campaign_stages.normal_story_beat: Daigo asks for a repeatable controlled run and, after it, gives the convoy a repaired radio aerial.
campaign_stages.hard_variation: Damp Bellmaker surface; later controlled braking and deliberate wider exits, with new mentor dialogue.

campaign_stages.normal_story_beat: A weather log contradicts the dry-road advice copied in the player diary.
campaign_stages.hard_variation: controlled mist, damp; maintain sight-line readability

campaign_stages.normal_story_beat: Emi admits that uncertainty is not the same as randomness. Read the actual surface.
campaign_stages.hard_variation: steady rain, wet; calibrated wet reference

campaign_stages.normal_story_beat: Reservoir Section challenges the convoy to name its reference point before chasing a number.
campaign_stages.hard_variation: dawn, damp; precision across expansion joints

campaign_stages.normal_story_beat: A loose mechanical pencil rolls across a map. Kaede points out how elevation changes the argument.
campaign_stages.hard_variation: clear night, dry; gear/exit emphasis

campaign_stages.normal_story_beat: Michi finds an old timing slip with a missing final sector, the first concrete sign of Zero Signal.
campaign_stages.hard_variation: night, wet; consistency across both laps

campaign_stages.normal_story_beat: Jun refuses to call the fastest accident a good run. The convoy has to show control.
campaign_stages.hard_variation: pre-dawn, damp; no arbitrary visibility loss

campaign_stages.normal_story_beat: Emi challenges an assumption made in the previous rain stage; she shares a weather notebook, not a victory sermon.
campaign_stages.hard_variation: Steady wet Rain Thread; longer safe lines and sharper traction-management benchmark, not secret grip.

campaign_stages.normal_story_beat: Harbour voices break the technical tension; a bold line is welcome if it remains legal.
campaign_stages.hard_variation: blue hour, dry; tighter long-arc exits

campaign_stages.normal_story_beat: Maya turns a rivalry into a poster and accidentally tells both sides what the other values.
campaign_stages.hard_variation: dawn, damp; measured urban-braking precision

campaign_stages.normal_story_beat: The convoy earns a place at a closed night event after helping the timing crew solve a small problem.
campaign_stages.hard_variation: night, wet; authored surface transitions

campaign_stages.normal_story_beat: Mako watches instead of racing, and notices who checks their friends' results first.
campaign_stages.hard_variation: pre-dawn, dry; torque-management emphasis

campaign_stages.normal_story_beat: Datum Works offers exact numbers and a very selective definition of success.
campaign_stages.hard_variation: dusk, damp; clean shoulder boundaries

campaign_stages.normal_story_beat: Chika asks why everyone talks about power before asking what the car feels like.
campaign_stages.hard_variation: night, dry; alternate support-rival lineup

campaign_stages.normal_story_beat: Jun measures a technically perfect run against a run that leaves options; the convoy earns a more useful respect.
campaign_stages.hard_variation: Cold damp Blackwater; altered braking-release pattern and legal car setup; Jun admits a changed assumption.

campaign_stages.normal_story_beat: Reina appears briefly and recognizes the old timing slip without acknowledging it.
campaign_stages.hard_variation: pre-dawn, damp; composure after compression

campaign_stages.normal_story_beat: A workshop argument reveals that Reina once depended on somebody she no longer mentions.
campaign_stages.hard_variation: night, wet; tighter safe braking envelope

campaign_stages.normal_story_beat: Fuyu describes the high road without turning it into a supernatural test.
campaign_stages.hard_variation: pre-dawn, dry; no artificial ice

campaign_stages.normal_story_beat: Kazuma plays an old, nearly silent radio recording. What is absent becomes important.
campaign_stages.hard_variation: cold night, damp; published wet setup

campaign_stages.normal_story_beat: Yuna reveals the restored dawn car. Shiori is nearby, asking about tyre temperatures.
campaign_stages.hard_variation: first light, dry; momentum through steep final sector

campaign_stages.normal_story_beat: The four marshal beacons are lit. Each represents a different way to lose or preserve momentum.
campaign_stages.hard_variation: dawn, dry; all four sectors assessed more tightly

campaign_stages.normal_story_beat: Mako drops the performance persona and asks whether the convoy can stay composed when everyone is watching.
campaign_stages.hard_variation: Wet Ember Drop; restrained exit-focused strategy replaces showy rotation; Mako foreshadows Shiori explicitly.

campaign_stages.normal_story_beat: Four Signals: the convoy must reconcile precision, controlled drift, braking and flow before the final invitation is accepted.
campaign_stages.hard_variation: Yuna conducts the same four-contract test with tighter legal targets and a different dialogue about preserving the car, before Shiori agrees to race.

campaign_stages.normal_story_beat: Reina races the convoy at Amanagi and must confront why a shared result need not erase individual skill. Include a real ending and meet epilogue.
campaign_stages.hard_variation: Shiori replaces Reina as the fixed final featured rival. Her restored V04 and measured momentum-focused dawn run are entirely legal; the ending completes the radio/timing-slip story.
